prs.body:
## Summary

The page heading now reads "Calc demo v2".

## Testing steps

1. In `site/`, run `python3 -m http.server 8000`.
2. Open http://localhost:8000/.
3. Confirm the heading reads "Calc demo v2".
4. Click the Add button and confirm the status text reads "Result: 5".
